original_idea.body:
# Importing Science and Technology Studies (STS) Regulatory Capture Analysis to AI Safety Governance

**Problem:** AI safety governance frameworks are drafted with significant input from the companies being regulated. STS literature on regulatory capture in other industries provides analytical tools to assess this risk.

**Direction:** Analyze NIST AI 800-1's development process using regulatory capture frameworks from STS literature (revolving door, comment capture, technical standard capture). Code the comment letter authors for industry affiliation. Measure industry vs. civil society influence on final document provisions. Apply to cybersecurity appendix specifically.

**Why it matters:** If AI safety governance standards are regulatory capture products, their stated safety goals are systematically undermined. STS analytical frameworks can detect this where technical analysis cannot.

**Relevant context:** NIST AI 800-1 70+ stakeholder comments; STS regulatory capture literature; Bengio et al. incentive alignment gap.
